lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.P450GroundEnergy.Solution.SevenGearWalk333.fast7gUnitProg
lean.annotation: The circuit prepares the 11-qubit phase-gradient register from zero with `approxPhaseGrad11Ray`, using at most 1,036 T gates once in the run. An ideal phase-gradient state is an eigenstate of modular addition, so an addition induces a phase and leaves the gradient state available for later rotations.

This entails ten preparations and ten circuit runs on average. Recognizing ground-state outcomes at finite precision requires a separate argument.
